Cosmog

Psychic

Alola · Generation 7 · Legendary Pokémon

Cosmog is a Psychic-type Nebula Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 0.2 m tall and weighs 0.1 kg. It evolves into Cosmoem. Its highest base stat is HP (43), with a base stat total of 200.
